Now I see the key issue. In `msFreeProjectionExceptContext`:
```c
projectionContext* ctx = p->proj_ctx;
p->proj_ctx = NULL;
msFreeProjection(p);
p->proj_ctx = ctx;
```

It saves `p->proj_ctx`, sets it to NULL, calls `msFreeProjection(p)` (which frees `p->args` and sets `p->args = NULL`, `p->numargs = 0`), then restores `p->proj_ctx = ctx`.

Now, in `msLoadProjectionString`:
1. `msFreeProjectionExceptContext(p)` - frees `p->args` (the array with args[0]=NULL), sets `p->args = NULL`, `p->numargs = 0`, restores `p->proj_ctx`
2. Then processes `one_line_def`:
   - `p->args = msStringSplit(trimmed, '+', &p->numargs)` - new array
   - `msProcessProjection(p)` - if fails, returns -1

Now, if `msProcessProjection` fails, `p->args` points to the new array. Then `loadProjection` returns -1, `loadMapInternal` fails, and `msLoadMap` calls `msFreeMap(map)`.

In `msFreeMap`, it calls `msFreeProjection(&(map->latlon))` or `msFreeProjection(&(map->projection))`. At this point, `p->args` points to the new array from `msStringSplit`, and `p->numargs` is set. So `msFreeProjection` should free it correctly.
